bench-and-bill.title: Kestrel Aerial wins approval for drone deliveries
bench-and-bill.author: Owen Brightwater
body: [f01: The Aviation Operations Board on Thursday approved Kestrel Aerial's drone delivery service.] [f02: Under the approval, a single pilot can oversee up to 20 drones at once.]
The board attached conditions. [f03: Flights are allowed only between sunrise and sunset.] [f04: Kestrel must report any crash or injury to the board within 24 hours.]
[f05: The approval lasts 2 years, after which Kestrel will have to apply again.] That's a lot of trust to place in software, and the board has left itself room to change its mind.

byteward.title: Kestrel Aerial gets approval for drone deliveries
byteward.author: Arlo Pennick
body: [f01: Kestrel Aerial has won approval from the Aviation Operations Board to deliver packages by drone.] [f06: Deliveries start December 1.]
[f07: Kestrel will launch first in the suburbs of Phoenix and Dallas.] [f03: The drones will only fly during daylight.]
For now, you'll need to live in the right neighborhood, and to order before dark.

launch-desk.title: Kestrel Aerial cleared for drone deliveries
launch-desk.author: Inez Calder
body: [f01: Kestrel Aerial is cleared to start drone deliveries.] [f06: The first orders fly on December 1.]
[f08: Each delivery will cost customers $3.99.] [f09: Grocery chain Pantryfield is Kestrel's first retail partner.]
[f10: Kestrel raised $180 million from investors in May.] Now it has to show that a drone can beat a delivery van on cost.

ohm-and-bit.title: Kestrel Aerial wins approval to deliver by drone
ohm-and-bit.author: Imogen Vale
body: [f01: Kestrel Aerial now has approval to run drone deliveries.] The aircraft behind it is worth a closer look.
[f11: Kestrel's drones carry packages of up to 5 pounds.] [f12: They have a round-trip range of 12 miles.] That's enough for groceries and medicine, not furniture.
[f13: Instead of landing, each drone hovers at 80 feet and lowers the package on a tether.] Nobody has to clear a landing pad in the yard.
[f02: One pilot can supervise as many as 20 of them at a time.] [f14: To make that safe, each drone carries a small radar that spots other aircraft on its own.]

wirefold.title: Kestrel Aerial wins drone delivery approval
body: The Aviation Operations Board on Thursday approved drone deliveries by Kestrel Aerial, allowing a single pilot to oversee as many as 20 drones.
